findings.what_happened: Checked that the agent identified the guest vocalist as Jonny Craig from passage [1], then judged that no band-membership-count evidence for Jonny Craig or Pete Doherty appears in the turn input. The agent assumed “The claim specifies that the guest vocalist on the album ... (likely Dance Gavin Dance, as that album features Jonny Craig)” and used that to motivate searching biographies. However, the turn input did not establish any link between the album/artist and Dance Gavin Dance; it only asserted the guest vocalist is Jonny Craig via passage [1] in a different turn’s input. Therefore this assumption is unsupported by this turn’s input data (it is an extraneous inference).
